ह्वे r. 1st cl. (ह्वयति-ते)
 1. To call.
 2. To invoke, to call upon.
 3. To
challenge.
 4. To name.
 5. To ask, to beg.
 6. To emulate, to vie
with, to wish to overcome or surpass.
 7. To struggle or contend
with. With आ, To call, to invite. With सम्, To call out together.
With उप, नि, वि or सम्, the verb is deponent, (उपह्वयते); also with
आङ् if rivalry be signified, (आह्वयते) He challenges.
THE END.
